title: Yellowed Springy Ukrainian Chicken Noodles
description: A sweet and springy Ukrainian dish featuring chicken, noodles, and shoyu-koji, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and utilizes a wok as the primary vessel.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper, then cook in a sous-vide machine at 140 degrees Fahrenheit for 1 hour.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat, then add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the wok and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cooked chicken to the wok, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic.
Add the shoyu-koji, honey, and gluten-free noodles to the wok, stirring to combine and cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the noodles are cooked and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the Yellowed Springy Ukrainian Chicken Noodles hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
Cooking time may vary depending on the specific gluten-free noodles used, so adjust the cooking time as needed.
